Theorem
[Claim 3 (uniform negative local entropy)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0193 ↗ def:chow-iii-adjoint-entropy-quantities 1. ch21:21.33–21.35\group Local entropy

After passing to a subsequence, there is $\beta _1>0$ and $\widetilde t_i\in [\bar t_i-\frac\alpha 2\bar Q_i^{-1},\bar t_i)$ such that \[ \int _{B_{g_i(\widetilde t_i)}(\bar x_i,\sqrt{\bar t_i-\widetilde t_i})} v_i(\widetilde t_i)\, d\mu _{g_i(\widetilde t_i)}\le -\beta _1. \] This assertion is invariant under the parabolic dilations (21.34).
